entities.summary: Albert Gordon "Bert, Spunk" Duncanson was a Canadian ice hockey player who competed in the 1932 Winter Olympics, winning a gold medal. He was the son of Duncan Duncanson and Elsie Back of Winnipeg, Manitoba.
